youtube.title: UNDER THE HOOD
youtube.summary: Graham Hood reflects on anger, resentment and conflict — and the cost of allowing them to consume us. From an angry co-pilot to today’s social media battles, Hoody asks what we can change, what we can’t, and whether we’ve forgotten how to have a conversation. Hoody and wife Michelle have just embarked on their month-long “ Hoody-on-a-Roady ” tour of New Zealand. Check out his tour schedule , and join in the conversation. Catch up on Hoody's earlier episode Fathers and the Cycle of Manhood Discover more from Hoody at Club Grubbery or find him on Facebook and X For stories you wont find on the 6pm news, get RCR Bites FREE every week day.

youtube.title: NATHAN SURENDRAN
youtube.summary: Paul Brennan checks back in with engineer and Wise Response Society chair Nathan Surendran, who warned earlier this year that New Zealand was sleepwalking into a fuel crisis. Nathan discusses shrinking global refining capacity, the flow-on effects of rationing by price, his challenge to Invercargill's spatial plan over its growth assumptions, the risks of leaning on AI for governance decisions and why tradable energy quotas should be back on the table this election. For more from Nathan find him on Substack , X and Instagram Check out Wise Response Society | What can I do in response to the Fuel Supply Crisis in Aotearoa New Zealand?
